This PR was closed automatically because it changes custom-layer content.
`custom/` is reserved for organization-specific knowledge and skills in
**your own fork**, not the shared upstream repository.

Keep company-only rules in your fork and point your host at that copy. The
[customization guide](https://github.com/microsoft/BCQuality/blob/main/docs/customizing-bcquality.md)
shows the complete flow.

If the guidance is useful to everyone, submit it to the layer that owns the
domain: Microsoft-owned domains belong under `microsoft/knowledge/`, even
when contributed by a partner; Community-owned domains belong under
`community/knowledge/`. See
[Contributing](https://github.com/microsoft/BCQuality/blob/main/docs/contributing.md).
BCQuality contains knowledge and skills, not agents.
